# Skill index — all 407 scored skills

<!-- Auto-generated table; to update: python3 eval/generate_readme_table.py -->

Every task skill in this repository is scored by the shared eval harness: Amazon Nova Pro
executes the skill against its test cases; gpt-oss-120b judges the run against the
[softaworks skill-judge](https://github.com/softaworks/agent-toolkit/tree/main/skills/skill-judge)
8-dimension / 120-point rubric; the **median of 3 judge runs** is committed as the scorecard.
Grade A ≥ 108/120. Two skills are unscored by design: `aws-orchestrator` (routes to other
skills rather than executing a task itself) and `skill-catalog` (a discovery index); one
deployer (`global-accelerator-endpoint-deployer`) has a judge run pending.

Per-skill artifacts live at `eval/scorecards/<skill>.json`; the dashboard summary is at
[docs/skill-judge-dashboard.md](docs/skill-judge-dashboard.md).
